allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same
                last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold'
                set to true and another owner already occupies that household; every
                owner in the household is given the same value. Absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's
                household (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more
                members after this owner was created. Otherwise 'SILVER' when
                the owner's namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present;
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
                - GOLD
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the
                fixed table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD; 'UNKNOWN'
                for any city not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether an unusually high number of owners have been created today.
                True once more than 80 owners have already been created for the
                current business day; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

  - name: owner-v2

  - name: users

  - name: pets

  - name: pet-v2

      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:

        - owners
      operationId: addOwner

      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.

        description: The pet owner

        required: true

            ETag:

              schema:
                type: string
          content:

        304:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678'
            is stored as '+61412345678'); the stored and returned value is that
            E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint used only when creating an owner. When true, an owner
            may be created even though another owner already has the same last name
            and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace);
            otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. This flag is
            never persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The pet owner's initials: the upper-cased first letters of the
                first and last names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The pet owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where
                LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and
                NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more
                than the number of owners at the time the owner was created.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two
                digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0007-M20'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners in the same household (same
                last name and address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed
                whitespace). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold'
                set to true and another owner already occupies that household; every
                owner in the household is given the same value. Absent otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and
                last name (compared case-insensitively) at the time this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The pet owner's membership tier. 'GOLD' when the owner's
                household (owners sharing the same householdId) has 3 or more
                members after this owner was created. Otherwise 'SILVER' when
                the owner's namesakeCount is 0 and an email is present;
                otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - BRONZE
                - SILVER
                - GOLD
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality

## Summary

I replaced the string membership tier with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3), touching four places:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Replaced the `membershipTier` string enum (`BRONZE`/`SILVER`/`GOLD`) property with a `membershipLevel` `integer` (int32, min 1, max 3). This regenerates `OwnerDto` with `membershipLevel`/`getMembershipLevel()` and drops `membershipTier`/`MembershipTierEnum`.

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — Swapped the tier-derivation expression for the level formula: `min(3, 1 + (email present ? 1 : 0) + (namesakeCount == 0 ? 1 : 0))`, null-safe on both fields. Computed in the mapper so both `GET` and create responses carry it.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`**:
   - Removed the `applyGoldTier(...)` helper and its `HOUSEHOLD_GOLD_THRESHOLD` constant, plus both call sites (the GOLD promotion operated on the now-removed `membershipTier`). Household-id assignment itself is untouched.
   - Updated the create **audit line** to record the level: it now maps the DTO first and logs `membershipLevel={}` alongside id/customerCode/registrationDate.

### Notes on interpretation
- The spec's "level 4 is reserved for tenure" is documented in the schema but not implemented — nothing in the spec assigns level 4 yet, and the cap is 3.
- The spec says "anything that recorded the tier (such as the create audit line) must record the level instead." The existing audit line didn't actually contain the tier, so I added `membershipLevel` to it to satisfy the requirement that the create audit line record the level. No test asserts the audit format, so this is a faithful-to-spec choice rather than a test-driven one — worth confirming if you had a specific audit format in mind.
